# vendored copy of phyriad-tokens 1.3.0

Copied, not linked: Tauri serves `ui/src` as `frontendDist`, so anything the window loads has to be
inside it. Do not edit these two files here — they are a verbatim copy of the upstream token package
(`phyriad.tokens.css`, `phyriad.base.css`), and the next sync silently reverts any local edit.

The palette is selected in `../index.html` with `data-palette="maid"`. Removing that one attribute
returns the launcher to the token package's default palette (oxide) without touching a stylesheet.

*Made with my soul - Swately <3*
